scenes: What keeps medicines and food safe in a heatwave?
The cold chain: every fridge and cool box | from the factory to the patient, or the plate.
Each year, five hundred and twenty-six million tonnes of food are lost for lack of refrigeration.
When the power fails in a heatwave, the chain breaks. | Solar fridges and back-up power keep vaccines safe.
Keep the chain cold, end to end.
